topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Well now, ain't that a turn of the plow none of us saw coming? Yonder, in the village, they're abuzz with the news. My wife, God rest her sweet soul, she'd have laughed, saying, "That young Alice, always had a way with words." Sure enough, Alice wrote a tale, every chapter dripping with our sadly familiar faces. I tell you, it's a fine read, this story of ours, crafted with care and the truth that only those who've sown the same fields could know. It's a strange thing, to be a character in someone else's heart, but there it is. The world might not be ready for it, but I am. After all, a good harvest comes from tending the soil, not ignoring it.
